coach_notes.text: Say their name twice in the first line.
Never open with 'How are you doing today?'
Use: 'Did I catch you at a bad time?' — never 'Is now a good time?'
If they can't move forward once a solution is found — cut the call.

coach_notes.text: Longest part of the call. Slow down. Concerned + curious tone.
Pain word — go deeper. Never move on from pain unless you can't go any deeper.
Under 7 probes — you likely left pain on the table.
Specific questions = 'the real deal'. Generic = tire kicker.

coach_notes.text: Never present price before this phase is done.
MOST IMPORTANT MOMENT: stay here until zero concerns.

coach_notes.text: Do NOT pause after the offer. No silence — straight to next steps.
Say 'the best you could get approved for was…' — never 'I'm offering you…'
Never negotiate live. Find the gap, take it to the team, move in small steps.
Ask for the close multiple times. 'Simple agreement to approve', never 'contract to sign'.

objections.speaker: seller
objections.disarm: I apologize that our offer was a little bit lower than YOU AND I were hoping for…
objections.overcome: What were you hoping I was AT LEAST going to say?

objections.speaker: seller
objections.disarm: Honestly… it may be better for you to list it with a realtor.
objections.overcome: If you have the money for repairs, cleaning, commissions, closing costs, and you're fine waiting 3–6 months and can handle the mortgage payment that long… it probably is the best fit. But is that something that truly makes sense for you?

objections.speaker: seller
objections.disarm: Your home definitely could be worth that much if we make repairs…
objections.overcome: Walk-away price vs listing price — run the math with their numbers: ~11% fees + $5–10k prep + monthly mortgage × months waiting.

objections.speaker: seller
objections.disarm: In fact, it's a good thing you're not in a rush — typically we can pay more if we have more time…
objections.overcome: Branch by occupancy: owner → where are you headed next? · tenant → buying more or hanging up landlord duties? · vacant → what came up now?

objections.speaker: seller
objections.acknowledge: Totally — if I were you I would do the exact same thing…
objections.disarm: I have two available slots tomorrow afternoon — which works best for you?
objections.overcome: Before you go — what questions do you think might arise, so I can be prepared for our next call?

objections.speaker: seller
objections.disarm: You definitely don't know enough about us or our process yet — in fact, I'm not even sure we can help you yet…
objections.overcome: What would make you feel more confident we're someone you can actually trust?

objections.speaker: seller
objections.disarm: I would never hop on a call without the hopes and intentions of buying your property…
objections.overcome: As long as you get the price we promise in the time frame we promise — does it REALLY matter how we cut the cake?

objections.speaker: seller
objections.disarm: If I were in your shoes, I wouldn't either…
objections.overcome: Would you spend hundreds of thousands on something you weren't allowed to see? …We can skip them, but the price will be significantly lower — worth it?

objections.speaker: seller
objections.disarm: If I were you, I would too.
objections.overcome: How much earnest money do you want? / What's your email so we can send the offer with proof of funds?

objections.speaker: seller
objections.disarm: Honestly, I'm not even sure we can help you yet — I still have to ask some questions about the property and situation.
objections.overcome: STRAIGHT to the next script question — don't dwell.

objections.speaker: seller
objections.disarm: I could be like everyone else and give you some BS lowball cash offer. I don't want to be like everyone else — answer these few questions and I'll get you something fair we can firmly stand behind.
objections.overcome: STRAIGHT to the next script question — don't dwell.
